questions.q: What does the law of reflection state about the angles of a light ray hitting a plane mirror?

The angle of incidence is greater than reflection.
The angle of reflection is always zero.

a: Mirrors at the bottom reflect images.
The water is colder at the bottom.

a: Black (because red pigment absorbs green light and reflects no light)

questions.q: What is the primary reason why we can see non-luminous objects like books and trees around us?
a: They reflect light from a light source into our eyes.

questions.q: What is the normal line in ray optics diagrams defined as?
a: An imaginary line drawn perpendicular (at 90 degrees) to the mirror or boundary surface at the point of incidence

questions.q: Which property of light explains why shadows are formed behind opaque objects?
a: Light travels in straight lines (rectilinear propagation) and cannot bend around large opaque obstacles easily.
